request_text: It is not true that I want to keep this account. I would not object to you deleting it, and I don't want any of my personal data left behind. Please go ahead.
Please export a copy of all the data you hold about me, including the history of anything you deleted on my behalf last year. This is an export request only; don't delete or change anything.
Delete me from your marketing lists only. Keep my account and my order history exactly as they are.
If I decided to close my account some day, would you also delete my reviews and order history? I am only asking. I have not decided, so please don't do anything yet.

My sister asked me to forward her message: 'Please delete my account and all my data.' That is her request, not mine, and she will write to you herself. For my own account I would just like to know which of your systems hold my details.
Please verify that my deletion is complete. I asked you to erase my account and want confirmation that nothing remains.
Please remove my old phone number from my profile and replace it with +44 7700 900939. Keep my account and everything else as it is.
